subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: What harness lifecycle contract should OpenClaw enforce when plugin reload or gateway startup resolves to an empty active plugin scope?
rationale: Current code can clear process-global harness state, but preserving every prior harness may keep disabled or unscoped plugin-owned code callable; the correct boundary is an ownership/product decision, not a mechanical retry choice.

options.title: Preserve Only Approved Always-On Harnesses
options.body: Filter preservation to maintainer-approved provider or always-on harnesses and clear plugin-owned harnesses that are disabled or outside the active scope.

options.title: Accept Restore-All Semantics
options.body: Allow previous harnesses to survive an empty active registry, but document and test that plugin disablement does not revoke those harnesses until a broader lifecycle reset.

options.title: Clear And Gate Dispatch
options.body: Keep empty scopes fail-closed and add readiness/retry behavior so channel or cron dispatch waits instead of surfacing a transient MissingAgentHarnessError.

recommendation.title: Preserve Only Approved Always-On Harnesses
recommendation.body: Filter preservation to maintainer-approved provider or always-on harnesses and clear plugin-owned harnesses that are disabled or outside the active scope.

likelyOwner.reason: The registry was introduced by steipete and the decision crosses agent harness, plugin lifecycle, and provider-routing ownership boundaries.
